example.el: Τα ελληνικά θέλουν εξάσκηση κάθε μέρα.
example.en: Greek needs practice every day.

example.en: The little boy was thrilled when he saw his presents.

example.el: Ο ύποπτος έχει άλλοθι για εκείνο το βράδυ.
example.en: The suspect has an alibi for that night.

gloss: promotion (at work); moving up a class

example.en: He got a promotion and now he's a manager.

example.en: There's a water leak under the sink.

example.en: He was desperate and didn't know what to do.

gloss: lady; missus; mistress of the house (colloq.)

example.en: Old Mrs Leni sells eggs in the neighbourhood.

example.en: The glasses are in the top cupboard.

example.en: Calm down, everything will be fine.

example.el: Είχαμε μια δυσάρεστη έκπληξη στο ξενοδοχείο.
example.en: We had an unpleasant surprise at the hotel.

example.en: — Are you coming with us? — Of course!
